```{r}
#| label: get-text
# Load text descriptions (similar to index.qmd)
generic_text <- read_yaml("source/generic-text.yml") %>%
    rapply(double_space, how = "replace")

city_text_file <- file.path(user_input_dir, "text-files/manual-text.md")
if (file.exists(city_text_file)) {
    city_text <- read_md(city_text_file)
    slide_texts <- merge_lists(city_text, generic_text)
} else {
    slide_texts <- generic_text
}

slide_texts <- unlist(slide_texts, recursive = F) %>%
  setNames(str_extract(names(.), "\\.(.*)$", group = T))
```




```{r}
#| label: slide-creation-function
# Flexible function to create new slides
create_slide <- function(pres, layout, master = "Base", labels = list()) {
  # Add the slide with specified layout and master
  pres <- add_slide(pres, layout = layout, master = master)

  # Iterate through the labels dictionary and add content
  for (label_name in names(labels)) {
    content <- labels[[label_name]]

    # Try to add content, skip if placeholder doesn't exist
    tryCatch({
      if (is.character(content)) {
        # if it's image content
        if (file.exists(content)) {
          pres <- pres %>%
            ph_with(value = external_img(content),
                    location = ph_location_label(ph_label = label_name))
        } else {
          # It's text content
          pres <- pres %>%
            ph_with(value = content,
                    location = ph_location_label(ph_label = label_name))
        }
      } else {
        # For other types - ggplots, ojs, etc
        pres <- pres %>%
          ph_with(value = content,
                  location = ph_location_label(ph_label = label_name))
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(paste("Could not add content to placeholder:", label_name, "- placeholder may not exist in layout"))
    })
  }

  return(pres)
}


```

#| label: title-slide
# Title Slide
title <- toupper(paste(city, country, sep = '\n'))
date <- toupper(paste(month.name[lubridate::month(Sys.Date())],
                     lubridate::year(Sys.Date()), sep = ' '))

cover_image_path <- tryCatch(
  fuzzy_read(file.path(output_dir, "maps"), "^aoi.png$", paste),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

pres <- create_slide(
    pres,
    layout = "Title Slide",
    master = "Base",
    labels = list(
      "Title" = title,
      "Date" =  date,
      "Image" = cover_image_path
    )
  )

## add introduction 
pres <- add_slide(pres, layout = "Introduction", master = "Base")

```{r}
#| label: create-slides-loop
slides_config <- read_yaml("source/slides.yml")

section_num <- 1 # initiate section numbering
# LOOP OVER SECTIONS
for (section_name in names(slides_config)) {
  section <- slides_config[[section_name]]
  section_title <- section$section_title

  subsection_num <- 1 # initiate subsection
  # LOOP OVER SUBSECTIONS -> INDIVIDUAL SLIDES
  for (item_name in names(section)) {
    if (item_name == "section_title") next

    slide_def <- section[[item_name]] # reads items

    # Skip if no layout defined
    if (is.null(slide_def$layout)) next

    labels <- list()

    # ------ CHECK IF TEXT IS AVAILABLE -------
    # Add Text - check slides.yml first, then generic-text.yml
    if (!is.null(slide_def$Text)) {
      labels[["Text"]] <- slide_def$Text
    } else {
      text_content <- slide_texts[[item_name]] # Uses text_xontent
      if (!is.null(text_content$method)) {
        # Get only first paragraph from method
        paragraphs <- strsplit(text_content$method, "\n\n")[[1]]
        labels[["Text"]] <- paragraphs[1]
      }
    }

    # takes  Footer from generic-text.yml footnote, may not be necessary
    text_content <- slide_texts[[item_name]]
    if (!is.null(text_content$footnote) && text_content$footnote != "NULL") {
      labels[["Footer"]] <- text_content$footnote
    }

    # ------ HANDLES TITLE IF INTRO (SECTION HEADER) -------
    if (item_name == "intro") { # intro is the section header slide
      labels[["Title"]] <- toupper(paste(section_num, section_title))

    } else if (!is.null(slide_def$title)) {
      labels[["Title"]] <- paste0(section_num, ".", subsection_num, " ", slide_def$title)
      subsection_num <- subsection_num + 1

      # GRABS PLACEHOLDER FROM LAYOUT
      for (placeholder_name in names(slide_def)) {
        if (placeholder_name %in% c("title", "layout")) next

        content_value <- slide_def[[placeholder_name]]
        if (!is.character(content_value)) next

        # Split by "/" to get folder and pattern
        parts <- strsplit(content_value, "/")[[1]]
        if (length(parts) == 2) {
          folder <- parts[1]
          pattern <- parts[2]

          # Search in the specified folder
          image_file <- tryCatch(
            fuzzy_read(file.path(output_dir, folder), paste0(pattern, ".*\\.png$"), paste),
            error = function(e) NULL
          )

          if (!is.null(image_file)) {
            labels[[placeholder_name]] <- image_file
          }
        }
      }
    }

    # Use section_name as master slide for main sections.
    master_name <- if (section_name %in% layout$master) section_name else "Base"
    # Create slides per subsection page
    pres <- create_slide(pres, layout = slide_def$layout, master = master_name, labels = labels)
  }

  section_num <- section_num + 1
}
```
